title: Who Really Pays a Tariff?
description:
A tariff is a tax on imported goods, collected at the border from the importing business. The cost often reaches shoppers as higher prices, though foreign sellers sometimes cut prices and share it.

Sources:
• Tax Foundation: Tariff: https://taxfoundation.org/taxedu/glossary/tariff/
